scripts.lint: cd backend && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cd ../frontend && bun run lint
scripts.format: cd backend && cargo fmt && cd ../frontend && bun run format
scripts.format:check: cd backend && cargo fmt --check && cd ../frontend && bun run format:check
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && cargo check --all-targets && cd ../frontend && bun run typecheck
scripts.test: cd backend && cargo test && cd ../frontend && bun run test
scripts.build: cd backend && cargo build && cd ../frontend && bun run build
